name: planrescue
description: PlanRescue: consequence-aware schedule recovery. Phase 0-4: MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with SQLite-backed get_schedule and get_tasks, and a deterministic Recovery Engine behind analyze_conflicts, propose_recovery_plan and validate_recovery_plan. The apps/web Next.js interface calls those tools through the official MCP client.

scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/time.test.ts tests/seed-data.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/server-meta.test.ts tests/database.test.ts tests/sqlite-schedule-repository.test.ts tests/sqlite-task-repository.test.ts tests/recovery-time.test.ts tests/recovery-task-capacity.test.ts tests/recovery-analyze.test.ts tests/recovery-generate.test.ts tests/recovery-validate.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build && vitest run tests/mcp-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build && vitest run tests/persistence.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run typecheck:web && npm run test:web
scripts.test:recovery: vitest run tests/recovery-time.test.ts tests/recovery-task-capacity.test.ts tests/recovery-analyze.test.ts tests/recovery-generate.test.ts tests/recovery-validate.test.ts
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e --prefix apps/web
